# oncallalert_user (Data Source)

Looks up a user by email address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oncallalert_user" "bob" {
  email = "bob@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `role` (String)
